exposure: Maternal-placental vascular malperfusion (MVM) level (low-grade vs. high-grade)
cohort: The study included all cases of fetal growth restriction (FGR) managed by a fetal medical center from 2018 to 2023.
finding: High-grade maternal-placental vascular malperfusion (MVM)-type FGR is significantly associated with a higher incidence of adverse neonatal outcomes, including cerebral hemorrhage and longer hospital stays, compared to low-grade MVM.
